positions.name: ProbeArtifactVerifiesReviewerEnrollment
positions.frame: what does this e2e probe artifact exist to verify about reviewer enrollment on memory save?
positions.why: src-1 states the decision the e2e suite enforces — saving a memory enrolls its creator as a reviewer — and src-2 declares the probe memory's sole reason for existing is to carry that assertion. Read together, both segments orient around the same locus: the artifact as a vehicle whose entire purpose is verifying the reviewer-enrollment rule. The directional observations reinforce this as one coherent read — both segments carry the same authority-ranking (suite enrolls, memory is subordinated to the rule), informational-control (speaker fixes the facts), and competence framing (correct behavior as the thing being checked) — rather than two independent claims.
